 Q-Lab Announces UVC Testing Capabilities at Accelerated Contract Test Services Facilities 
Q-Lab Announces UVC Testing Capabilities at Accelerated Contract Test Services Facilities
News & Press
Last Updated 2021
Q-Lab is pleased to announce the addition of UVC testing capabilities to both our Florida (USA) and Saarbrücken (Germany) ISO 17025-accredited contract test laboratories. Testing is performed using our newest model, the QUV/uvc accelerated weathering tester.
As a result of the covid-19 global pandemic, surfaces in hospitals, airplanes, ventilation systems, and more have been exposed to potentially damaging, short-wavelength UVC light as part of UVGI (ultraviolet germicidal irradiance) processes. Since most products have not been designed with UVC stability in mind, this testing can give critical information about your materials’ and products’ resistance to high-energy UVC light.
Available testing parameters include a wide range of temperatures and irradiance values, to suit most applications.
The QUV/uvc weathering tester builds upon over 50 years of pedigree, with thousands of testers in the field. It sets the bar for cost-effective, easy-to-use weathering equipment and is considered “the world’s most widely used weathering tester.”
What happens to your product when exposed to UVC light? Don’t guess when you can test!
Contact: testing@q-lab.com (Florida); info.de@q-lab.com (Germany)
Q-Lab Corporation is a global leader in accelerated weathering and corrosion testers, contract testing services, and standard test panels for paints. More information on Q-Lab's products and test services, including the QUV/uvc accelerated weathering tester, can be found by visiting www.q-lab.com.
